description: Resolve the self-contradiction in the .claude auditor prompt (C.8 requires browser+E2E while F.19/F.20 forbid them) and fix the stale B.5 web ordering, for cam-cli only.

userStories.title: Fix auditor prompt C.8 and B.5 for cam-cli terminal reality
userStories.description: As the PRD auditor for cam-cli, I need checklist items C.8 and B.5 in .claude/agents/subagent-auditor.md to reflect that cam-cli is a terminal CLI (no browser/server/DB), so that C.8 stops producing a spurious critical finding (browser verification required) that contradicts F.19/F.20, causes a false BLOCK, and burns a re-plan round toward plan-escalated.
acceptanceCriteria: C.8 (line ~66) in .claude/agents/subagent-auditor.md no longer requires browser verification AND an E2E test for UI-touching stories. [oracle: bash -c '! grep -nE "browser verification AND E2E|browser verification.*E2E test" .claude/agents/subagent-auditor.md']

The rewritten C.8 states that UI/Ink stories are verified via ink-testing-library (render + assert on the actual screen output / glyph), and that genuine interactive ceremonies (e.g. keypress) are flagged requires:operator, never browser/E2E, because cam-cli is a terminal CLI with no browser/server/DB. [oracle: grep -q 'ink-testing-library' .claude/agents/subagent-auditor.md]

C.8 as rewritten is consistent with F.19 (:92) and F.20 (:93): no instruction tells the auditor to both require and flag browser/E2E, and C.8 does not demand a database/server check. [oracle: reviewer-judgment]

B.5 (line ~60) implementation-ordering guidance is updated from the generic web ordering (DB -> server -> client -> tests -> E2E) to the cam-cli ordering (types -> core -> surface -> polish). [oracle: bash -c "grep -q 'types' .claude/agents/subagent-auditor.md && ! grep -nE 'DB . server . client . tests . E2E' .claude/agents/subagent-auditor.md"]

The templates/agents/subagent-auditor.md copy is unchanged (generic web-app template retained), so no re-embed and no embed-vendor:check are needed for this story. [oracle: bash -c 'git diff --quiet -- templates/agents/subagent-auditor.md']
Agent frontmatter validation still passes for the edited file. [oracle: bun scripts/smoke/check-agent-frontmatter.ts .claude/agents/subagent-auditor.md]
Lint spine passes. [oracle: bun run check:all]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
userStories.notes: Single file: .claude/agents/subagent-auditor.md (C.8 at line 66, B.5 at line 60). This is intentional self-hosting (declared edit to .claude/agents/*), so auditor rule F.23 should NOT flag it as harness drift. Do NOT touch templates/agents/subagent-auditor.md: its generic web-app C.8/B.5 are coherent for downstream web projects and the divergence is by-design (see memory: cam-dual-copy-is-per-file). Because templates/ is untouched, embed-vendor:check is NOT part of this story's gates. ink-testing-library ^4.0.0 is already a devDependency, used in test/dashboard.test.ts, test/ui/init-setup-screen-keys.test.ts, test/ui/dashboard-story-row.test.tsx, so the tool the rewrite references genuinely exists. Keep the trailing LF byte and frontmatter block intact (check-agent-frontmatter.ts guards it). This is a functional fix: spurious C.8 critical -> false BLOCK -> burned re-plan (MAX_REPLAN_ROUNDS=2) -> plan-escalated (plan-runner.ts:847).
